fix: Hold the camera the way a photographer really does: the left hand cradles the left end of the camera from below, the right hand grips the right end, thumbs on the back of the camera, the right index finger resting on the small shutter button on the top plate. Fingers touch only the two short ends and the underside: no finger covers or touches the lens, the lens ring, the flash window, the viewfinder window or the gold Retra wordmark, and no hand or finger touches the face. Exactly five natural fingers per hand, relaxed and correctly jointed.
